correctness.rationale: All translations diagonalize the scale-weighted frame operator with multiplier WQ+∑_{t≠0}h(t)ζ^(tξ). Constancy on the nonzero characters iff h(t)=β for every t≠0 follows by inverse Fourier transform, giving three necessary and sufficient u/v pair-balance regimes, with strictly positive bounds. The full-space condition forces h=0, and zero-one transversals and subgroup criterion follow algebraically. For normalized difference wavelets deleting one scale subtracts (2−2cos(2πk/p))/p; actual minimum/maximum cosines yield both sharp extrema, p=3 zero and p≥5 positive. Bounded independent p checks supplement the proof.
